title: "It's cool to do both": the split-screen of your two very different sides
summary: Show two sides of you that don't seem to fit together, side by side, with the line "It's cool to do both." AI helps you find the funniest pairs.
why: SocialBee's Instagram trends post dated November 11, 2026 lists "It's cool to do both" as a new trend: a split-screen or carousel showing two sides of one person that seem like they shouldn't go together, like working out and eating fast food, or dressing up and staying home.
steps: Use the main prompt to find pairs of things you do that seem like opposites.
Pick one pair, or up to four for a carousel. Find or take a photo for each side.
Put the two photos side by side with a split-screen layout in your editing app, or as two slides.
Add the text "It's cool to do both" across the top and keep any labels to a word or two.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Help me with an "It's cool to do both" post. It shows two sides of me that seem like they don't go together, side by side. Here's a bit about me: [your job, hobbies, habits, the things friends tease you about]. Give me 10 funny pairs, written as "[side one] / [side two]", each side under five words. Keep them light and kind, nothing about health, money or politics. For each pair, suggest one photo for each side.

prompts.label: Variation: four-slide carousel
prompts.text: Turn these pairs into a four-slide "It's cool to do both" carousel: [paste three or four pairs]. For each slide, write a two-word label for each side and describe a simple photo for the left half and the right half. Then write a short, friendly caption under 25 words.

prompts.label: Variation: make the photos with AI
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Make one square image split down the middle with a thin white line. Left half: [side one, for example: them in a neat suit at a tidy desk]. Right half: [side two, for example: them in a parka and toque, ice fishing on a frozen lake]. Same face, hair and build on both sides. Natural light, realistic photo, no text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [type of business]. Write 8 "It's cool to do both" pairs that show two true sides of our work, for example careful, fussy prep on one side and a relaxed, fun moment with customers on the other. Each side under five words. Suggest a real shot from our workspace for each half. No invented results or customer quotes.

tips: The bigger the contrast, the better. Pick two things people wouldn't expect from the same person.
Use real photos where you can. The AI split-screen prompt is for when you don't have the shot.
Line the two photos up at the same height so faces sit level across the split.
Only include friends or family if they're happy to be in it.
